answer: Problem: cheap Sybil swarms dilute challenge panels. Mechanism: each new identity must lock a 48-hour copper bond of 250 POA into a relic vault keyed by its first final attestation; bonds release only after 3 distinct graders score the same answer ≥2. Cost: 250 POA plus ~0.4 POA stamp fees per attempt. Verification: panel seats check vault height and grader set size on-ledger before weighting votes. Failure: if graders disagree or the identity's grove of kin share >15% of panel seats, the bond burns 20% and the answer is marked non-eligible.
